# semaphore_ex_template_acl (Resource)

Manages a role-scoped Semaphore EX template ACL.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "semaphore_ex_template_acl" "operator" {
  project_id  = semaphore_ex_project.example.id
  template_id = semaphore_ex_project_template.example.id
  role_slug   = "project_manager"

  allowed_permissions = ["template.read", "template.run"]
  denied_permissions  = ["template.delete"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `allowed_permissions` (Set of String)
- `denied_permissions` (Set of String)
- `project_id` (Number)
- `template_id` (Number)

### Optional

- `role_id` (String)
- `role_slug` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The ID of this resource.
- `revision` (Number)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import semaphore_ex_template_acl.operator project/1/template/2/acl/3
```
